description: This file defines the StreamCacheConfig interface which provides configuration settings for a streaming cache in the Search service. It includes method signatures for retrieving the dispatcher name and retry delay, as well as an inner enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: StreamCacheConfig
classes.description: An interface for cache configuration settings related to streaming cache behavior in the Search service.

classes.name: StreamCacheConfig.StreamCacheConfigValue
classes.description: An enum providing default configuration values and config paths for the cache settings.

methods.name: getDispatcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatcher to execute async cache loaders.

methods.name: getRetryDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay duration before retrying an out-of-date cache query.
